reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the Sn-doping strategy and its mechanism (Sn-rich interfacial layer suppressing pest oxidation) from Nb-silicide based alloys (P9, P11, P13) to equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr without new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence. The proposal is essentially the same intervention and predicted outcome reported in the cited passages, merely applied to a different alloy system.
copied_elements: adding ~5 at.% Sn to suppress pest oxidation
formation of Sn-rich interfacial layer (Nb3Sn, etc.)
improved scale adhesion and reduced oxidation weight gain
